items.headline: United States Completes Military Withdrawal From Iraq After Two Decades
items.summary: The United States has formally completed the withdrawal of its military forces from Iraq, ending over twenty years of U.S. military presence in the country. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi officially declared the conclusion of the U.S.-led coalition's mission, signaling a major transition in Middle Eastern security.

items.headline: Google Launches First AI Prototype Satellite into Orbit with SpaceX
items.summary: On October 1, Google launched a prototype satellite carrying four custom artificial intelligence processors aboard a SpaceX rocket as part of its Project Suncatcher initiative. The mission tests how AI hardware and specialized cooling systems withstand space radiation and orbital extremes to evaluate the future of space-based data centers.

items.headline: Arsenal Surrenders Two-Goal Lead in 2-2 Draw With Paris FC in Women's Champions League
items.summary: Arsenal surrendered a two-goal lead on Wednesday to draw 2-2 against Paris FC in their UEFA Women's Champions League match. Goals from Alessia Russo and Georgia Stanway put the English side ahead before Maeline Mendy scored an 86th-minute penalty equalizer for Paris FC.

items.headline: Sotheby's Unveils $450 Million Collection of Unseen Masterpieces by Van Gogh and Cézanne
items.summary: On September 30, 2026, Sotheby's revealed a collection of twelve long-unseen Impressionist and post-Impressionist paintings valued at roughly $450 million. The rare private collection, which includes major works by Vincent van Gogh and Paul Cézanne, will go up for auction in New York on November 18.
